results.reason: Process powershell.exe was detected by the report "Command and Control - AMSI - .Net Attempting Suspicious Network Connections" in watchlist "AMSI Threat Intelligence"
results.report_name: Command and Control - AMSI - .Net Attempting Suspicious Network Connections
results.report_description: Malware may try and evade detections by leveraging fileless methods for Command & Control and downloading follow-on stages of their attack. This detection is looking for a common fileless technique related to the .Net subsystem's built in web client classes. If you receive an alert for this detection your should take immediate action to ensure its not related to malicious behaviors.
results.ioc_hit: (fileless_scriptload_cmdline:system.net.webclient OR fileless_scriptload_cmdline:system.web.webrequest OR fileless_scriptload_cmdline:net.webclient OR scriptload_content:system.net.webclient OR scriptload_content:system.web.webrequest OR scriptload_content:net.webclient) AND (-fileless_scriptload_cmdline:"https://chocolatey.org" OR -scriptload_content:"https://chocolatey.org")

results.reason: Process powershell.exe was detected by the report "Execution - AMSI - PowerShell Downloading Behaviors Detected" in watchlist "AMSI Threat Intelligence"
results.report_name: Execution - AMSI - PowerShell Downloading Behaviors Detected
results.report_description: PowerShell is widely used by attackers and administrators alike. It can be leveraged to download strings via the common System.Net.WebClient class, sending data to and receiving data from a resource identified by a URI. Various common methods of malware authors to download additional payloads include DownloadData, DownloadString, and DownloadFile, which all download data from a resource (a URL/URI). To further evade detection, these commands can be run in memory as well. This is a common tactic for downloading second stage payloads in malicious word doc campaigns and for pulling whitelisting bypasses and scripts from open source websites such as Github.
results.ioc_hit: (fileless_scriptload_cmdline:.downloadfile OR fileless_scriptload_cmdline:.downloaddata OR fileless_scriptload_cmdline:.downloadstring OR scriptload_content:.downloadfile OR scriptload_content:.downloaddata OR scriptload_content:.downloadstring) AND NOT (fileless_scriptload_cmdline:chocolatey.org* OR scriptload_content:chocolatey.org*)
